messages.subject: Including paired subjects in groupComparisonTMT (MSstatsTMT)
parts:
Hi MSstatsTMT team,

I'm using MSstatsTMT package to analyze our dataset, which contained 18 samples in 5 conditions (biological replicates included). They belonged to 1 mixture and there were no technical replicates. There are some pairing information between subjects of different conditions (e.g. subject1 in condition1 is matched to subject1 in condition2, subject2 in condition1 is matched to subject2 in condition2). Is it possible to include this information when comparing samples in different conditions?

Thank you so much!

Best,
Hongya

messages.author: 2889aa2e61425c8e
messages.subject: Re: Including paired subjects in groupComparisonTMT (MSstatsTMT)
parts:
Dear Hongya,

Yes this is possible, and what you describe is the correct thing to do. Use the same subject identifier for all the subjects in the pair, and MSstats will recognize that this is a paired design.

HTH
Olga
